''Entwined with the words of this thick book is a powerful magical effect that grants a permanent Point to spend in your Epic Destinies.'' 

'''Tome of Destiny''' grants a permanent +1 [[Destiny Point]] to spend in your [[Epic Destinies]].
* All tomes are Minimum Level: 20
* DDO Store tomes are {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}.
** Tomes from Ultimate bundles are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}.
* Tome provided a [[Inherent bonus]] type and do not stack with other [[inherent bonus]] types. Different types stack with each other.
* Bonuses from tomes persist through [[Reincarnation]].
* Unwanted tomes have no available trade-in option.

Acquired by:
* Purchase from the [[DDO Store]]
* As noted below for each variant

== Variants ==

There are multiple types of destiny tomes. Different types stack with each other.
* Feywild
** [[Fables of the Feywild]] ultimate bundle – tomes granted for all current and future characters (part of Feywild Ultimate Fan Bundle Claim Ticket)
** Tomes are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}.
* Historic
** Automatically granted 1/server to all accounts that owned Epic Destinies before the release of [[Update 51]].
*** Note: It was initially possible to unlock Epic Destinies from a total of four sources - direct purchase from the [[DDO Store]], and as part of the [[Menace of the Underdark]], [[Fables of the Feywild]] and [[Sinister Secret of Saltmarsh]] expansions. You will receive one copy of the Tome ''per'' original unlock method, all on the same character, whenever you log into a server with unclaimed Tomes. Although they do not stack, they are Bound to Account and can be passed to another character via the Shared Account Bank.{{Ref|{{Forums|p=6473739}}{{Forums|527900}}}}
* Dread
** [[The Isle of Dread]] ultimate bundle – infinite tomes available from [[Zalnathe]] after purchase
** Tomes are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}.
== UI location ==

How to locate Destiny and Fate points acquired and from which tomes:
* You can check your [[Epic Destinies]] tree UI → Mouse-over "Destiny Points Spent" → a pop with a complete break down will appear, look for "From Destiny Tomes". It will list tomes used on that character.{{Image popup|[[File:Destiny Points Spent breakdown.png|thumb|right|Complete break down of Destiny and Fate points.''(mouse-hover for pop-up)'']]|Destiny Points Spent breakdown.png|width=600}}
